final: WITH telescope_avgs AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL GROUP BY telescref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals WHERE pulsepersec IS NOT NULL), first_kept AS (SELECT ta.telescref, ta.avg_pulse FROM telescope_avgs ta CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE ta.avg_pulse > o.avg_pulse), second_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_pulse FROM first_kept), final_kept AS (SELECT fk.avg_pulse FROM first_kept fk CROSS JOIN second_avg sa WHERE fk.avg_pulse > sa.avg_pulse) SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS mean_average_pulse_rate, AVG(avg_pulse - (SELECT avg_pulse FROM overall)) AS mean_excess_overall_average, AVG(avg_pulse - (SELECT avg_pulse FROM second_avg)) AS mean_excess_over_second_average FROM final_kept
